<style>
.chat-root{display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:620px;border:1px solid #d8ddd8;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.chat-sidebar{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr);border-right:1px solid #dde2dd;background:#f6f5f1}
.chat-side-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #dde2dd}
.chat-side-head strong{font-size:11px}
.chat-channels{overflow:auto;padding:6px}
.chat-channel{display:grid;width:100%;gap:2px;padding:9px;border:0;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:#294b56}
.chat-channel:hover,.chat-channel.active{background:#e5efed}
.chat-channel strong{overflow:hidden;font-size:9px;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.chat-channel small{font-size:7px;color:#778783}
.chat-main{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;min-width:0}
.chat-main-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e4df}
.chat-main-head h3{margin:0;font-size:14px}
.chat-messages{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:8px;overflow:auto;padding:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfaf7,#f2f5f2)}
.chat-message{display:grid;gap:3px;max-width:min(680px,82%);padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #d9e1dc;border-radius:10px;background:#fff}
.chat-message.mine{justify-self:end;border-color:#b8d8d2;background:#e7f3f0}
.chat-message-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.chat-message-head strong{font-size:8px}.chat-message-head time{font-size:6.5px;color:#83908c}
.chat-message-body{font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.chat-compose{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid #dde2dd;background:#fff}
.chat-compose-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end}
.chat-empty{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:40px;color:#76827e;text-align:center}
.chat-modal{width:min(560px,94vw);border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:16px}
.chat-members{display:grid;max-height:260px;overflow:auto;gap:4px;margin:8px 0}
.chat-member{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px;border-radius:7px;background:#f4f5f2;font-size:8px}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .chat-root{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:720px}
 .chat-sidebar{max-height:210px;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #dde2dd}
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.CHAT=async ctx=>{
 const {el,button,call,status,richEditor}=App;
 const root=ctx.root;
 const state={bootstrap:null,channel:null,messages:[],timer:null};
 const me=String(App.state.boot?.email||'').toLowerCase();

 const side=el('aside',undefined,'chat-sidebar');
 const sideHead=el('div',undefined,'chat-side-head');
 sideHead.append(el('strong','Conversas'),button('+ Nova',()=>openCreate(),true));
 const channels=el('div',undefined,'chat-channels');
 side.append(sideHead,channels);

 const main=el('div',undefined,'chat-main');
 const mainHead=el('div',undefined,'chat-main-head');
 const mainTitle=el('h3','Selecione uma conversa');
 const mainMeta=el('small','Chat interno CIDIJUS','hint');
 mainHead.append(el('div'),mainMeta);
 mainHead.firstChild.append(mainTitle);

 const messages=el('div',undefined,'chat-messages');
 const compose=el('div',undefined,'chat-compose');
 const editor=richEditor('','Escreva uma mensagem…');
 const send=button('Enviar',()=>sendMessage(),false);
 const composeActions=el('div',undefined,'chat-compose-actions');
 composeActions.append(send);
 compose.append(editor.root,composeActions);
 main.append(mainHead,messages,compose);
 root.append(side,main);

 function channelName(c){return c.nome||'Conversa';}
 function renderChannels(){
   channels.replaceChildren();
   const list=state.bootstrap?.canais||[];
   if(!list.length){channels.append(el('p','Nenhuma conversa disponível.','hint'));return;}
   list.forEach(c=>{
     const b=el('button',undefined,'chat-channel'+(state.channel?.id===c.id?' active':''));
     b.type='button';
     const unread=Number(c.naoLidas||c.nao_lidas||0);
     b.append(
       el('strong',channelName(c)+(unread?' · '+unread+' nova(s)':'')),
       el('small',c.tipo==='SISTEMA'?'Canal institucional':((c.totalMensagens||0)+' mensagem(ns)'))
     );
     b.onclick=()=>selectChannel(c);
     channels.append(b);
   });
 }

 function renderMessages(){
   messages.replaceChildren();
   if(!state.channel){messages.append(el('div','Selecione uma conversa para começar.','chat-empty'));return;}
   if(!state.messages.length){messages.append(el('div','Ainda não há mensagens nesta conversa.','chat-empty'));return;}
   state.messages.forEach(m=>{
     const mine=String(m.autor||'').toLowerCase()===me;
     const row=el('article',undefined,'chat-message'+(mine?' mine':''));
     const head=el('div',undefined,'chat-message-head');
     head.append(el('strong',m.autorNome||m.autor||'Usuário'),el('time',new Date(m.criadoEm).toLocaleString('pt-BR')));
     const body=el('div',undefined,'chat-message-body');body.innerHTML=m.conteudo||'';
     row.append(head,body);messages.append(row);
   });
   messages.scrollTop=messages.scrollHeight;
 }

 async function refreshMessages(silent=true){
   if(!state.channel)return;
   const data=await call('chatMensagens',{canalId:state.channel.id,limit:150},false,{noLoader:silent});
   if(!App.alive(ctx)||state.channel?.id!==data.canalId)return;
   state.messages=data.mensagens||[];renderMessages();
   state.channel.naoLidas=0;
   state.channel.nao_lidas=0;
   renderChannels();
   call('chatMarcarLido',{canalId:state.channel.id},true,{silent:true}).catch(()=>{});
 }

 async function selectChannel(c){
   state.channel=c;mainTitle.textContent=channelName(c);mainMeta.textContent=c.tipo==='SISTEMA'?'Canal geral do CIDIJUS':'Conversa interna';
   renderChannels();await refreshMessages(false);editor.focus();
 }

 async function sendMessage(){
   if(!state.channel){status('Selecione uma conversa.',true);return;}
   if(!editor.getText().trim())return;
   send.disabled=true;
   try{
     await call('chatEnviar',{canalId:state.channel.id,conteudo:editor.getHtml()},true);
     editor.setHtml('');await refreshMessages(true);
   }finally{send.disabled=false;}
 }

 function openCreate(){
   const dialog=el('dialog',undefined,'chat-modal');
   const form=el('form');
   const title=el('h3','Nova conversa');
   const name=el('input');name.placeholder='Nome da conversa';name.required=true;name.maxLength=120;
   const memberBox=el('div',undefined,'chat-members');
   const picked=new Set();
   (state.bootstrap?.usuarios||[]).forEach(u=>{
     if(String(u.email||'').toLowerCase()===me)return;
     const label=el('label',undefined,'chat-member');
     const check=el('input');check.type='checkbox';check.onchange=()=>check.checked?picked.add(u.email):picked.delete(u.email);
     label.append(check,el('span',(u.nome||u.nomeUsuario||u.email)+(u.funcao?' · '+u.funcao:'')));
     memberBox.append(label);
   });
   const actions=el('div',undefined,'actions');
   actions.append(button('Cancelar',()=>dialog.close(),true));
   const save=el('button','Criar conversa');save.type='submit';actions.append(save);
   form.append(title,name,el('p','Selecione os membros do CIDIJUS.','hint'),memberBox,actions);
   form.onsubmit=async ev=>{
     ev.preventDefault();save.disabled=true;
     try{
       const result=await call('chatCriar',{nome:name.value,membros:[...picked],tipo:'GRUPO'},true);
       dialog.close();await load();const found=(state.bootstrap?.canais||[]).find(c=>c.id===result.canal.id);if(found)await selectChannel(found);
     }finally{save.disabled=false;}
   };
   dialog.append(form);document.body.append(dialog);dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>dialog.remove(),{once:true});dialog.showModal();name.focus();
 }

 async function load(){
   state.bootstrap=await call('chat',{},false,{noLoader:true});
   if(!App.alive(ctx))return;
   renderChannels();
   if(!state.channel&&(state.bootstrap.canais||[]).length)await selectChannel(state.bootstrap.canais[0]);
 }

 await load();
 state.timer=setInterval(()=>{if(App.alive(ctx))refreshMessages(true).catch(()=>{});else clearInterval(state.timer);},8000);
};
</script>
